QuestInfo.name: Alchemical Traces
QuestInfo.2: #p2300004# believes that Dark Alchemy was involved with the research of the Xenoroids. Go to #bMagatia#k to find some supporting evidence. She's given you a letter of recommendation to get past the less-than-friendly people of Magatia. Take this letter to #bCarson#k, the head of the Zenumist Society, and #bMaed#k, the head of the Alcadno Society.

0.0: Hi. I called you to run an errand for me.
0.1: I'm from #bMagatia#k originally. Many alchemists and scientists come from the Zenumist and Alcadno academies. Their #bresearch on magic#k basically produced alchemy, including the forbidden branch...
0.2: That would be the magic that #bcreates life#k. Only a select few even know of its existence. I believe #p2154009# is one of them. You and your little friend seem to indicate some form of life creation...
0.3: Go to Magatia and find out more about the #bforbidden research#k. More specifically, #p2154009#'s involvement#k in it.

yes.0: I will give you a letter to help you with the investigation. Hold on for a moment.

no.0: This matter involves the safety of Magatia and, perhaps, all of Maple World. It's not to be ignored.

1.0: Both the Zenumist and Alcadno academies are closed to the public because of the clandestine nature of their research. You won't find any friends there as an outsider.
1.1: Show them this #bletter#k and mention my name when you arrive. They should give you passage.

yes.0: The relationship between these two academics is quite sour, so their buildings are at the opposite ends of the city. First, visit #bCarson#k in the Zenumist Society, on the #bthe left edge of Magatia#k.
